2358-4551-8089.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and 1 life, adding {B}
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

533-2097-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
533-2097-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

553-1470-1927.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Vedalken Orrery.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

792-1580-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1879-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1879-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1879-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2265-3099-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Hardened Scales and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

141-5256-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-5256-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4499-6723-6965-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1558-3875-4231-5621-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-5621-6753.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

443-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

369-997-2730.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2060-4499-5070-7107.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Nykthos Paragon.
When Nykthos Paragon enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Nykthos Paragon's toughness.
Nykthos Paragon triggers, causing you to put that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5231-6794.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

985-5078-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

147-3269-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3269-5231.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3269-5231.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

1263-2034-2060-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2034-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

2265-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Hardened Scales.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
2265-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

341-1690-2364-2538.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Umori.
341-1690-2364-2538.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
341-1690-2364-2538.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1459-1912-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control except Galadriel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Galadriel.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead choose any of Galadriel's modes.

643-1219-4221-4438-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1219-4221-4438-4499.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1558-2963-4072-4840.description:
Activate Daretti's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating a 1/1 Construct artifact creature token.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and Construct, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1331-3129-4979-5157.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Gilded Goose.
You control at least two Foods.
1331-3129-4979-5157.description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Gilded Goose to deal six damage to itself.
Gilded Goose dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Gilded Goose from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.

3199-3209-4365.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
3199-3209-4365.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

1309-3603-4050-5316.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Tura Kennerüd triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
Repeat.

261-1424-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
261-1424-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Suture Priest and gaining you 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
